name: The Radio Tower
hours: A relay mast and hut on the north-west ridge beyond Umbra House, serviced by a mainland engineer twice a year.
sight: A red-and-white lattice mast stands on a bald knuckle of the ridge, guyed with cables that moan in the wind. At its foot a concrete hut holds racks of humming equipment, a logbook, a camp chair and a hand-cranked emergency set under a dust cover. From the door you see both coasts at once. Static and wind are the only weather here.
things: Climb the first ladder stage for the view (do not climb the second)
Listen to the monitor speaker: The Top Deck going out, ship traffic, static
Try the hand-cranked set and raise a mainland operator
Find the fox-hole shelter the Outdoor Club uses
Watch a storm front cross the sea like a wall
Tune across the dial slowly, late in the day
secret: The island's only link out besides the ferry: campus phones, The Top Deck's uplink and the Chancellor's line all pass through this hut — which is why news is so easy to control (a single patch panel; Vicar has had the student uplink 'under maintenance' since Day 41 except for vetted broadcasts). Bex and Teobalt can restore it; the hand-cranked set works regardless. The logbook: 'Day 27 — all bands, 02:10, eleven minutes of dead carrier. Not interference. ABSENCE.' From D27, tuning slowly near the top of the dial at dusk picks up a soft regular clicking in groups — a board being set up. It is how the Guest 'listens to the island'; if Rowan transmits on that frequency, something on the Commons beach turns its head. The gale of Day 117 brings down a guy cable; repairing it with Silas is a trust scene.
access: Hut padlocked (silas; the engineer; bex knows the hasp is loose). West of the cordon line.
